case_number: 2024 INSC 391; CIVIL APPEAL N0. 1389 OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (C) No.11136 of 2023)
summary: Election petition replication validity; statutory remedy under Representation of Peoples Act, 1951; replication permitted as clarification not new plea; Section 81 timing bar addressed; Order VIII Rule 9 CPC applicability; no prejudice to returned candidate; High Court discretion affirmed; election petition pleadings clarified through replication.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 O.VIII R.9
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order allowing replication upheld.
